behaviour: load_config(overrides) deep-merges overrides into DEFAULTS: nested keys not overridden keep their defaults, and DEFAULTS itself is never mutated.
prompt: After setting only `database.port` in the overrides, the app crashes because `database.host` is gone. load_config() should keep every default that is not overridden, at any depth. Find and fix the bug (it may not be in loader.py) so `python3 -m pytest -q` passes. Do not modify the tests.
acceptance: python3 -c "from config.loader import load_config, DEFAULTS; c = load_config({'database': {'port': 1}}); assert c['database'] == {'host': 'localhost', 'port': 1, 'options': {'timeout': 5, 'ssl': False}}; assert DEFAULTS['database']['port'] == 5432"
